mil3.1.10:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of faith?”
mil3.1.10:1.3: “Faith, Great King, has the characteristic of clarifying, and the characteristic of leaping in.”
mil3.1.10:1.4: “How, venerable sir, does faith have the characteristic of clarifying?”
mil3.1.10:1.5: “Faith, Great King, when it arises, suppresses the hindrances, and the mind, free from hindrances, becomes clear, serene, and unclouded.
mil3.1.10:1.6: That, Great King, is how faith has the characteristic of clarifying.”
mil3.1.10:2.2: “Just as, Great King, a wheel-turning king, traveling a long road with his army of four divisions, might cross a small stream, and that water, churned up by elephants, horses, chariots, and foot soldiers, would become turbid, disturbed, and turned to mud.
mil3.1.10:2.3: And when the wheel-turning king had crossed over, he would command his men, ‘Bring drinking water, sirs; I shall drink’, and the king would have a water-clearing jewel.
mil3.1.10:2.4: ‘Yes, Your Majesty,’ those men would reply to the wheel-turning king, and they would drop that water-clearing jewel into the water; as soon as it was dropped into the water, the shells, moss, and algae would disappear, the mud would settle, and the water would be clear, serene, and unclouded.
mil3.1.10:2.5: Then they would offer drinking water to the wheel-turning king: ‘Please drink the water, Your Majesty.’
mil3.1.10:3.1: As the water, Great King, so should the mind be seen; as those men, so should the meditator be seen; as the shells, moss, and algae and the mud, so should the defilements be seen.
mil3.1.10:3.2: As the water-clearing jewel, so should faith be seen; just as, when the water-clearing jewel is dropped into the water, the shells, moss, and algae disappear, the mud settles, and the water becomes clear, serene, and unclouded;
mil3.1.10:3.3: so too, Great King, faith, when it arises, suppresses the hindrances, and the mind, free from hindrances, becomes clear, serene, and unclouded.
mil3.1.10:3.4: That, Great King, is how faith has the characteristic of clarifying.”
